description.fun: Teddiursa is almost always licking its paws, which are soaked in honey, and every Teddiursa's paws taste different. It licks them to calm its nerves, and the crescent moon on its forehead glows when it finds honey, whether it blends its own from fruit and pollen gathered by Beedrill or sneakily follows Combee home to raid their nest. Its name blends teddy bear with ursa, Latin for bear.
description.guide: A Normal-type bear cub Pokémon with a crescent-moon mark on its forehead, known for licking honey from its paws. It hides food around its territory before winter. It evolves into Ursaring, which can evolve into Ursaluna.
description.tagline: A honey-pawed bear cub with a crescent moon on its brow

description.fun: Ursaring marks trees bearing good fruit with its claws, then snaps them to shake down the food, and its nose can find a meal buried underground or in a stream. The ring on its chest nods to the Asian black bear, the 'ring-of-the-moon bear' in Japanese. Oddly, in Gold and Silver its line was a Silver exclusive in Japan but a Gold exclusive in English.
description.guide: A large Normal-type bear Pokémon, the evolution of Teddiursa, with a yellow ring-shaped mark on its chest. It has a keen sense of smell and loves honey. It evolves into Ursaluna when exposed to a Peat Block under a full moon.
description.tagline: A ring-marked bear that snaps trees to shake down dinner

description.fun: Ursaluna is thought to have appeared when Ursaring in Hisui were exposed to its swampy peat under a full moon, and it wades through swamps with ease and can shape peat to its advantage. The moon on its forehead peeks out between cloud-shaped brows. Its nose can track down missing people, and a special Ursaluna, descended from an ancient Pokémon blessed by Arceus, serves as a Ride Pokémon in the Crimson Mirelands.
description.guide: A Ground- and Normal-type Pokémon from Legends: Arceus, the evolution of Ursaring, which evolves when exposed to a Peat Block under a full moon. It moves easily through swamps and finds things by smell. A unique Bloodmoon Ursaluna lives in Kitakami.
description.tagline: A mud-caked Hisuian bear born of peat and the full moon

description.fun: Bloodmoon Ursaluna is one very old bear that drifted from Hisui to Kitakami long ago and is said to be the last of its kind, with a blood-red moon on its brow, iron-hard mud over half its face and a left eye that sees in the dark. Unlike other Ursaluna, it walks on its hind legs, and its look comes from neither evolution nor a form change.

transitions.how: Peat Block, under a full moon

note.text: Ursaring evolves when exposed to a Peat Block under a full moon, a method from Legends: Arceus. Scarlet and Violet have the evolution in their code but no way to trigger it.
